description: Fetch the Markdown for a single BANKSapi docs page. Accepts a docs path (e.g., /guide/quickstart) or a full URL; any .md/.html suffix and section index (e.g. /guide) are handled. For the API reference paths /api/banks-connect, /api/ai-connect and /api/pay-connect this returns a compact operation index rendered from the OpenAPI spec. Use when you need specific page content or code samples. Prefer 'search-banksapi-docs' for broader questions. Call 'get-banksapi-overview' first to get a list of available pages.
name: get-banksapi-docs-page
title: Get BANKSapi docs page
